title: Interventional Care Pathways
problem: interventional psychiatry clinics need care-pathway visibility that connects patient experience, treatment cadence, insurance friction, and outcomes without flattening clinical nuance.
direction: A local pathway analytics workbench that simulates ketamine/TMS-style treatment journeys, flags drop-off risk, and explains operational bottlenecks by clinic, payer, and care step.
why: Radial operates clinics and its CEO has publicly tied the mission to lived patient experience. The project targets the operational details that make treatment feel navigable for patients.

archetypes.name: interventional evidence replay
archetypes.trigger: interventional signal changes while psychiatry context is stale
archetypes.expected: block release until cited evidence is regenerated

archetypes.name: psychiatry boundary probe
archetypes.trigger: psychiatry handoff crosses a policy or trust boundary
archetypes.expected: route to reviewer with evidence packet

archetypes.name: clinics regression harness
archetypes.trigger: clinics behavior regresses against the last accepted fixture
archetypes.expected: open a regression issue with trace and benchmark delta

archetypes.name: care-pathway operator packet
archetypes.trigger: care-pathway output needs a human-readable audit packet
archetypes.expected: accept only if decision claims cite fixture evidence
